## Submission

- Prompts: `prompts/<harness>/`
- Results: `results/<harness>/`
- Run notes / replies / memory changes:

## What happened?

Describe what the harness built, what worked, and where it struggled.

## Steering and deviations

Confirm whether the owner correction was supplied before pass 5. Describe other human input, departures from the starting context, early stops, and any manual or post-run edits. If none, say so.

## Run and verify

Give the commands needed to run the result locally and list the checks you actually performed, their outcomes, and known limitations.

## Before submitting

- [ ] Both folders use the same harness/run name.
- [ ] Prompt files contain the actual submitted text, in order; steering is recorded separately.
- [ ] The final source and any final guidance/memory files are included, with local run instructions.
- [ ] The pass count is accurate, and an incomplete run is labelled as such.
- [ ] The original starter, challenge context, and existing submissions are unchanged.
- [ ] Shared artifacts contain no credentials or private data; any redactions are identified.
